title: Verify the kit in Roblox Studio and capture real previews
goal: Turn 'type-checked' into 'actually works in Studio' and get honest screenshots for the listing.
measurable_target: 14/14 steps of docs/STUDIO_TEST_CHECKLIST.md pass; >= 4 real screenshots or 1 short GIF.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 checklist steps pass (or failures were fixed and re-tested)
No red errors in the Output window during the play-test
At least 4 real in-Studio screenshots saved (quests, spin, shop, backpack)
human_steps: Install Roblox Studio (free) if you don't have it.
Work through docs/STUDIO_TEST_CHECKLIST.md and fill in the Result column.
If a step fails, copy the Output error text into a new Claude Code session and ask for a fix; rebuild with tools/build.py.
Take screenshots of the 4 panels and save them to products/roblox-creator-starter-kit/media/.
Replace the HTML mockups on landing-page/index.html with the real screenshots (optional but recommended).
